message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to up‑to‑date weather or environmental monitoring feeds, so I can’t tell you what the current air quality index (AQI) is in Los Angeles at this exact moment.  

For the most accurate and timely information, check one of the following:

| Source | How it works |
|--------|--------------|
| **AirNow** (airnow.gov) | Real‑time AQI readings from EPA‑approved stations across the U.S., including Los Angeles County. |
| **EPA’s Air Quality System (AQS)** | Historical and near‑real‑time data sets if you want deeper analytics. |
| **Local news outlets** (e.g., *Los Angeles Times*, KABC, KNBC) | Often publish daily summaries and alerts when AQI reaches unhealthy levels. |
| **Mobile apps** such as “Plume Labs – Air Report” or “Weather Underground” | Provide push notifications and maps showing current conditions. |

If you’re planning outdoor activities today, those resources will give you the latest AQI values, pollutant breakdowns (PM₂.₅, ozone, etc.), and health advisories specific to your location within the city.
message.reasoning:
The user asks about current air quality in LA. We need real-time data; we can't fetch live info. According to policy, cannot provide inaccurate or unverified information. Should respond with disclaimer and suggest checking reliable sources like AirNow.gov or local news.
